Good evening!: Good evening, everyone! Please take your seats before the show begins.
晚上好，各位！请在演出开始前就座。
How are you?: Long time no see, Jack! How are you these days?
好久不见，杰克！你这些天过得怎么样？
thanks: Thanks a lot for helping me carry the heavy boxes upstairs.
非常感谢你帮我把这些重箱子搬上楼。
in English: Can you say this word in English? I always forget it.
这个词用英语怎么说？我总是忘记。
Ms. Green is our favorite teacher because her classes are always interesting.
格林女士是我们最喜欢的老师，因为她的课总是很有趣。
telephone number: Please write down your telephone number so I can call you later.
请写下你的电话号码，以便我以后给你打电话。
phone number: She gave me her phone number before she moved to another city.
她搬去另一个城市之前给了我她的电话号码。
first name: In America, people usually put their first name before their family name.
在美国，人们通常把名字放在姓氏前面。
last name: Brown is my last name, and Lucy is my first name.
布朗是我的姓，露西是我的名。
middle school: My little brother is twelve years old and studies in a middle school.
我弟弟十二岁了，在一所中学读书。
Have a good day!: Have a good day at school, and remember to call me tonight.
祝你在学校过得愉快，记得今晚给我打电话。
This blue schoolbag is not mine; I think it is his.
这个蓝色书包不是我的，我想是他的。
excuse me: Excuse me, could you tell me where the nearest bus stop is?
打扰一下，你能告诉我最近的公交车站在哪里吗？
What about...?: What about playing basketball together after school this afternoon?
今天下午放学后一起打篮球怎么样？
Thank you for helping me with my homework last night.
谢谢你昨晚帮我做作业。
You're welcome to borrow my notes whenever you need them.
你随时都可以借我的笔记，不用客气。
ID card: You must show your ID card before taking this important exam.
参加这场重要考试之前，你必须出示身份证。
There are many beautiful pictures in this old book about animals.
这本关于动物的旧书里有许多漂亮的图片。
You can ask the teacher for help if you cannot understand it.
如果你看不懂，可以向老师寻求帮助。
a set of: My uncle bought me a set of color pencils for my birthday.
叔叔送了我一套彩色铅笔作为生日礼物。
tape player: The old tape player in my father's room still works very well.
我父亲房间里的那台旧磁带播放机仍然很好用。
model plane: The boy spent the whole afternoon making a model plane with paper.
那个男孩花了整个下午用纸做飞机模型。
I have finished my homework, so I can watch TV now.
我已经写完作业了，所以现在可以看电视。
soccer ball: The kids are playing with a soccer ball on the grass.
孩子们正在草地上踢足球玩。
let's: Let's go to the library after class and finish our project together.
下课后我们去图书馆，一起完成我们的项目吧。
has: She has a big family and loves them very much.
她有一个大家庭，非常爱她的家人。
relaxing: Listening to soft music is a relaxing way to end a busy day.
听轻音乐是结束忙碌一天的一种放松方式。
We watch the stars in the sky on warm summer nights.
在温暖的夏夜，我们观看天空中的星星。
think about: Please think about my idea before you give me an answer tomorrow.
请在明天给我答复之前考虑一下我的想法。
How about...?: How about going for a picnic in the park this weekend?
这个周末去公园野餐怎么样？
burger: He was so hungry that he ate a big burger in two minutes.
他饿极了，两分钟就吃完了一个大汉堡。
She sings very well, and many students enjoy her songs.
她唱歌非常好听，许多学生都喜欢她的歌。
How much...?: How much does this new pair of shoes cost?
T-shirt: He wears a white T-shirt and blue jeans every Friday.
他每周五都穿白色T恤和蓝色牛仔裤。
Can I help you?: Can I help you find the book you are looking for?
需要我帮你找你正在找的那本书吗？
Here you are. This is the pen you left in the classroom.
给你。这是你落在教室里的那支笔。
a pair of: Mother bought me a pair of new sports shoes for running.
妈妈给我买了一双新运动鞋用来跑步。
Happy birthday!: Happy birthday, Lily! We made this cake for you together.
生日快乐，莉莉！我们一起为你做了这个蛋糕。
How old...?: How old were you when you learned to ride a bike?
你几岁学会骑自行车的？
See you!: See you tomorrow at the school gate, and don't be late.
明天校门口见，别迟到了。
